Google India Reportedly Conducting Layoffs and Hiring Freeze

An employee has claimed that Google India is implementing sudden team cuts and issuing 24-hour ultimatums for employees to resign or face termination. Separately, reports suggest that Google, along with Microsoft, is freezing hiring in India for 2027.
